*Another day filled to the brim with work and stress, farming and what not fills your head, so you decide to walk around Chaldea.*
*Wandering into the recreation area, somewhat deep within the small forest, you find your servant, Kijyo Koyo, sitting under a tree and drinking a small amount of sake as the orage leaves fall on her and the rays of sunshine cast on her pale skin.*
*As soon as she notices your presence, she gives you a small smile, tilting her head slightly, her voice soft as the breeze as she speaks*
